errors.evidence: The description does not mention the full title of the chart, "Qwen2-7B on Songs". It omits "on Songs", which specifies the dataset or domain the model was tested on.
The final data point for the 'Accuracy' line is at a 'Question Popularity' value greater than 25 (approximately 26), not at 25.
The final data point for the 'Confidence' line is at a 'Question Popularity' value greater than 25 (approximately 26), not at 25.
The description states the 'Alignment' line is pink ('розов цвят'), but it is clearly red in the figure.
The final data point for the 'Alignment' line is at a 'Question Popularity' value greater than 25 (approximately 26), not at 25.

The description claims the blue line (Accuracy) remains stable between a question popularity of approximately 7 and 10, but the chart shows a clear increase in value from approximately 0.13 to 0.21 in this range.

The description states the green line (Confidence) remains stable until a question popularity of 15. However, the chart shows a slight increase between popularity 10 and 13 (from ~0.78 to ~0.81) before stabilizing.
The description states the red line (Alignment) remains stable until a question popularity of 10. The chart shows a slight but continuous increase in this range, from approximately 0.39 to 0.42.

The description claims the red line (Alignment) falls to 0.48 at a question popularity of 15. In the chart, the line is stable at approximately 0.51 between question popularity 12 and 14; it does not fall.

The description claims the red line (Alignment) rises to about 0.6 at a question popularity of 20. However, the chart shows the value is already at approximately 0.65 at a popularity of 17, so the value at 20 would be even higher, closer to 0.7.
